sources.section: Antibody responses induced by meningococcal vaccines
sources.quote: Two years after immunization, there was still a significant concentration of polysaccharide-specific IgG response induced by MPSV4, whereas the response induced by the primary dose of MCV4 had declined, although it stayed substantially above baseline (Fig. 1a).

claim_10.claim: Serum bactericidal activity assay (SBA) analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed that MPSV4 induced a rapid increase in serum bactericidal activity detectable by day 7, peaking at day 30 and remaining above baseline at day 750 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.section: Antibody responses induced by meningococcal vaccines
sources.quote: Both vaccines induced a rapid increase in serum bactericidal activity (SBA), which was detectable as early as day 7, peaked at day 30, began to decline by day 180, yet remained substantially above baseline at day 750 (Fig. 1d).

sources.section: Antibody responses induced by meningococcal vaccines

claim_13.claim: Serum bactericidal activity assay (SBA) analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MPSV4 (n=13) and MCV4 (n=17) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed no difference between vaccine groups in maintaining protective SBA titers of 1:8 or higher at two years after inoculation (day 750).

sources.section: Antibody responses induced by meningococcal vaccines
sources.quote: An SBA titer of 1:8 or higher, a correlate of protective immunity 22, was maintained in the majority of MPSV4 and MCV4 vaccinees two years after inoculation, with no difference observed between the two vaccine groups (Fig. 1d).

claim_14.claim: anti-DT IgG capture microsphere assay analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) at days 0, 7 and 30 post-vaccination showed that MCV4 elicited a strong anti-diphtheria toxoid IgG response at days 7 and 30 compared to baseline (day 0) and compared to MPSV4.

sources.section: Antibody responses induced by meningococcal vaccines
sources.quote: MCV4, which contains the diphtheria toxoid (DT) protein as a conjugate, elicited a strong anti-DT IgG response at days 7 and 30, whereas MPSV4 containing polysaccharide alone did not (Fig. 1e).

claim_19.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMCs from MCV4 vaccinees at days 0, 3 and 7 post-vaccination showed 1,150 differentially expressed genes at day 7 whose pattern bore the hallmark of antibody secreting cells compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.section: Workflow to compare vaccine transcriptomic signatures
sources.quote: At day 7 post-vaccination, we identified 1,150 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in MCV4 vaccinees (Fig. 2a). These DEGs bear the hallmark of antibody secreting cells (ASC), which is consistent with the enhanced frequencies of these cells (Fig. 1f).

claim_20.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMCs from MCV4 vaccinees at days 0, 3 and 7 post-vaccination showed that the XBP1 network was highly enriched among upregulated genes at day 7 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.section: Workflow to compare vaccine transcriptomic signatures
sources.quote: This XBP1 network is also highly enriched for up-regulated genes at day 7 post-MCV4 vaccination (Supplementary Fig. 2).

claim_21.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMCs from MPSV4 and MCV4 vaccinees at days 0, 3 and 7 post-vaccination showed only a small number of differentially expressed genes at day 3 for both vaccines and at day 7 for MPSV4 compared to baseline (day 0).

claim_22.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMCs from vaccinees across five vaccine studies showed that several B cell genes, including TNFRSF17, were upregulated at day 7 in MCV4 and TIV compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Several B cell genes were up-regulated at day 7 in MCV4 and TIV vaccinees (Fig. 3b), including TNFRSF17, a B cell differentiation gene that is predictive of antibody responses to the YF-17D and TIV vaccines 4, 6.

sources.section: Comparative differential gene expression analysis

claim_37.claim: DNA microarray analysis of blood transcriptomes from YF-17D, TIV and MCV4 vaccinees, using blood transcription module analysis at day 7 post-vaccination, showed that plasma cells and immunoglobulin modules were positively correlated with antibody responses in TIV and MCV4 but inversely correlated with antibody titers in YF-17D.

sources.section: Distinctive transcriptional programs in vaccine antibody responses
sources.quote: Interestingly, these plasma cells and immunoglobulin modules, as well as memory B cell modules, are inversely correlated to antibody titers in YF-17D (Supplementary Fig. 12e, Supplementary Table 2), which is the opposite of what was observed with TIV and MCV4, where there is a positive correlation with the antibody responses (Supplementary Fig. 20).
